If not found, `save_host(host)` will call `host.host = ...` and crash with `NoMethodError`, and `host.destroy` in `destroy` will also crash. This is a real correctness issue visible in the diff (lines ~10-16 and ~23).

records.rationale: In Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host, the code directly dereferences nested params (`params[:embeddable_host][:host]` / `[:category_id]`). If the `embeddable_host` key is missing, this will raise (NoMethodError) and 500; if `:host` is absent it assigns nil to `host.host`, which can lead to validation errors/failed saves. The diff shows no guarding/strong-params usage to prevent this.
